name: WorkspaceMediaSlot
centralRule: Panel geometry defines the media slot; the source never sizes the panel. Media adapts to the panel.
declaration: data-media-slot (box) + data-media-fit (cover / contain + default focal) + --pw-focal (explicit focal metadata)

scope.geometryDefaults: mobile (≤699px), shared primitive (.pw-media) — tablet / desktop compositions keep their approved media boxes
scope.caps: a max size is enforced through the inline size: min(100%, maxBlock × aspect) — the aspect always holds, a cap never crushes a frame into an undeclared strip
scope.containFits: all widths, strong (a declared no-crop beats an inherited cover)
scope.coverAndDefaultFocal: zero-specificity defaults (art-directed crops keep zoom + position)

frameOwnership.primitive: SLOT — aspect + capped size from WORKSPACE_MEDIA_SLOTS (mobile), panel layout at every width
frameOwnership.composition: COMPOSITION — authored frame (tab CSS / density layer per tab); fit, focal, radius and missing state from the slot contract

missingAsset: slot keeps its geometry and renders the named empty state (data-asset-state="missing"); no broken-image icon; row-scale slots (ROW_THUMB / LOGO_MARK) keep the hatched state and move the name to the tooltip

ROW_THUMB.responsive: fixed square that scales with the HUB unit; never grows with the source

STRIP_THUMB.responsive: fills its cell up to the cap; block size from the aspect (aspect holds under the cap)

CARD_MEDIA.responsive: media on top of a card; capped (aspect holds) so text stays the primary read

PORTRAIT.responsive: portrait slot with upper-third focal point

FEATURE_MEDIA.responsive: side media of a featured panel; stacks above text on narrow phones

HERO_PLATE.responsive: band height from the HUB hero (--hero-h); copy sits on a wash, never on raw imagery

UI_CAPTURE.responsive: contain inside a backdrop; whole capture legible

BOARD_PREVIEW.responsive: miniature board / plate preview inside the DESIGN chamber; the chamber composition owns the box, the slot owns the fit
